Description
Next to Stanley Park with unobstructed views of Coal Harbour, Marina, park and Mountains at Bayshore Gardens. Bright corner unit has 2 bedrooms plus large den with window & huge balcony featuring top quality finishing throughout with floor to ceiling wrap windows. Unit features include A/C, Electric Blinds for all blinds in the unit, Beautiful high end Appliances and much more. Definitely a must see ! BONUS: This unit includes 2 EV equipped parking stalls & a large storage locker !
